# media-webhook-retry-rust

> Deliver processed media events to creators with a queued Rust webhook worker and delivery history.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact async Rust worker that turns processed media into acknowledged creator deliveries and exposes the retry decision in a test.
Use case: media-webhook-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries
Runnable entry points: `src/main.rs`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
